title: The AI Skill I Rely On Daily — Priscila Andre de Oliveira, Sentry
talk_summary: A Sentry senior engineer describes how she analyzed 116 of her own Claude sessions and found 67% of her AI usage was comprehension, not code generation, so she built a local 'catch me up' skill that structures codebase-understanding questions into six exploration modes (architecture, convention, feature trace, syntax, testing, history). She argues the biggest unlock of AI in a large codebase is comprehension and that humans must understand agent research before planning/implementation.

takeaways.technique: Session-log mining to find repeated prompts
takeaways.what_they_do: Had Claude analyze her own chat history (116 sessions) and classify prompts into categories to discover which prompts repeat and are worth turning into a reusable skill.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it analyzed it 116 sessions and it classified everything in six categories

takeaways.technique: Structured 'catch me up' comprehension skill with fixed exploration modes
takeaways.what_they_do: A single markdown skill file that forces comprehension questions into six modes (architecture, convention, feature trace, syntax, testing, history) and outputs visual structure (organogram, tables, flow) instead of free-form prose.
takeaways.evidence_quote: structures those comprehension questions in two six exploration modes. Architecture, convention, feature trace, syntax, testing, and history.

takeaways.technique: Insert a human/agent 'understand the research' gate between research and planning
takeaways.what_they_do: Extends the research→planning→implementation loop with an explicit comprehension step where the human reads and steers the agent's research before allowing a plan.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's missing this step like you need to understand the research your agent did

takeaways.technique: Comprehension skill as PR-review context builder
takeaways.what_they_do: Uses the same skill before reviewing a colleague's PR to build the missing context needed to approve confidently.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I use this skill to give me that

takeaways.technique: Dedicated quality/debt quarter to keep codebase agent-legible
takeaways.what_they_do: Sentry spent three months removing any-types, TODOs, unused flags, and simplifying code so the codebase stays understandable to both humans and agents.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we used this time just to improve our code base. So remove all the any types
